name: Koshi Machiya
description: Koshi Machiya — a machiya townhouse stay theme laid out like a seasonal magazine, with a formal top header: the house name and tagline on the left, the Book a stay button on the right, and on wide screens the menu as a fixed sumi-ink side rail of numbered entries down the left edge (an overlay menu on phones and tablets). Kaki persimmon (#ED6D3D) is the main colour: the cover hero, the story band, every page head and the overlay menu are persimmon fields with a faint koshi-lattice texture, set in sumi ink. The hero is a stacked collage: three torn pencil sketches of the lane, the tatami room and the courtyard, taped and overlapped, with a cut-out townhouse breaking out of the collage and over the hero bottom edge. Editorial layout: an issue line and contents list on the cover, a feature spread with a two-column drop-cap lead and a pull quote, the rooms on a staggered numbered grid, the year 1910 in giant type on the story band, where a cut-out persimmon branch breaks over the top edge. Every picture is a graphite pencil sketch with persimmon coloured-pencil accents. Shippori Mincho B1 for display, Instrument Sans for reading, Noto Serif TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b4-2 (editorial-magazine, stacked-collage hero, side-rail nav, collage, pencil-sketch, kaki #ED6D3D, Shippori Mincho B1 + Instrument Sans, travel-stays). A formal top header: house name and tagline on the left, the Book a stay button on the right; from 1100 px the menu is a fixed sumi-ink side rail of numbered entries down the left edge (vertical entries in Chinese and Japanese), an overlay menu on phones and tablets. Editorial magazine: issue line and contents list on the cover, a feature spread with a two-column drop-cap lead and a pull quote, numbered rooms on a staggered grid, the story band with the year in giant type. Collage: torn-edged pencil sketches taped and overlapped on the hero, the story band and every page head. Break-frame: the cut-out townhouse (transparent WebP) stands in front of the stacked sketch collage and breaks over the hero bottom edge into the at-a-glance box; the cut-out persimmon branch breaks over the top edge of the persimmon story band and over the bottom edge of every page head. Traditional Chinese headings use a bundled Noto Serif TC Bold subset (mincho, matching Shippori Mincho B1).

summary.zh-TW: 柿色雜誌風的町家包棟住宿：鉛筆素描撕紙拼貼、去背町家破框而出，左側固定直排選單，含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: A persimmon magazine for a machiya stay: torn pencil-sketch collage, a cut-out townhouse breaking out, a fixed side-rail menu.
summary.ja: 柿色の雑誌のような町家の一棟貸し。鉛筆スケッチのちぎり絵コラージュ、枠を飛び出す町家、左の固定メニュー。五か国語つき。
summary.fr: Un magazine couleur kaki pour une machiya : collage de croquis déchirés, maison détourée qui déborde, menu en rail latéral.
summary.de: Ein kakifarbenes Magazin für ein Machiya: Collage aus Bleistiftskizzen, ausbrechendes Stadthaus, feste Seitenleiste.
